title: Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — Rating Manual: Placement Experience Modifier
content:
**Placement experience modifier — Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs, residential placement schedule (Lender-Placed Flood – Residential Mandatory Amount tier).** The rated amount of a new placement is multiplied by a modifier worked out from the program's own claim experience:

- **Program in force 36 months or more.** The modifier is 1 plus one half (0.5) of the amount by which the program's 36-month placement loss ratio exceeds 0.40 (a ratio below 0.40 lowers it), kept no lower than 0.85 and no higher than 1.25. That loss ratio is the claim payments issued under the program's certificates in the last 36 months less the claim payments voided in those 36 months, divided by the lender payments the program received in those 36 months, and it is zero when no lender payment was received in that window.
- **Program in force at least 12 but fewer than 36 months.** The modifier is 1.10 when any claim payment was issued under the program's certificates in the last 12 months and 0.97 when none was.
- **Program in force fewer than 12 months.** The modifier is 1.00.

Months in force are the whole calendar months from the program effective date to today, a month counting only once its day of the month is reached; a window of the last N months covers every entry dated on a day from which fewer than N such whole months have passed by today. Claim payments and voids are dated by the day they were issued or voided; lender payments by the day they were received.

## Hypothetical worked figures (program in force 36 months or more)

| Net claim payments, 36 months | Lender payments, 36 months | Loss ratio | 1 plus one half of (ratio less 0.40) | Modifier |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 14,000 dollars | 20,000 dollars | 0.70 | 1.15 | 1.15 |
| 2,000 dollars | 40,000 dollars | 0.05 | 0.825 | 0.85 (floor) |
| 45,000 dollars | 30,000 dollars | 1.50 | 1.55 | 1.25 (cap) |
| any | none received | 0 | 0.80 | 0.85 (floor) |

## Points of judgement

- *A program in force 20 months had one claim payment 11 months ago, later voided.* A claim payment was issued in the last 12 months, so the modifier is 1.10.
